updates.content:
Title: Some users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail

User impact: Users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Exchange Online and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail

User impact: Users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail.

Current status: We're reviewing the information provided by some reporting users to better understand this issue and determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Some users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail.

Next update by: Thursday, October 8, 2026, at 4:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail

User impact: Users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail.

More info: Impacted users receive the following error "Mail sent to the wrong Office 365 region. ATTR35."

Current status: We've identified a potential root cause related to a service-side testing process. We're working on a remediation plan to correct this issue and restore service. This information may be updated as our investigation continues. 

Scope of impact: Some users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail.

Next update by: Thursday, October 8, 2026, at 6:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may intermittently fail

User impact: Users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may have intermittently failed.

More info: Impacted users received the following error "Mail sent to the wrong Office 365 region. ATTR35."

Final status: We have stopped the service-side testing and reversed the changes it had made. We've confirmed with both service-side telemetry and multiple users' feedback that this issue is now resolved. We've stopped the service-side testing, reversed the changes it had made, and confirmed with service-side telemetry and user feedback that this issue is now resolved.

Scope of impact: Some users' email messages from on-premises Exchange servers to Exchange Online may have intermittently failed.

Start time: Thursday, October 8, 2026, at 10:06 AM UTC

End time: Thursday, October 8, 2026, at 4:05 PM UTC

Root cause: A routing service-side testing process created a Domain Name System (DNS) issue resulting in this impacting event. 

Next steps: 
-We're reviewing our service side testing processes and checks to ensure that impact is avoided or to notify admins ahead of time to potential downtime periods so that preventative actions can be taken.

This is the final update for this event.
